GNG_BOP_Construction_Initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DOP_construction_tab_enabled } }
		set_temp_variable = { TabName = token:BoP_Tab_DOPConstruction }
		TNO_BoP_GNG_AddTab = yes
		set_country_flag = DOP_construction_tab_enabled
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DOP_construction_initialized } }
		DOP_construction_initialize_variables = yes
	}
	DOP_construction_sync_selected = yes
}

DOP_construction_sky_tower_recalculate = {
	set_variable = { DOP_construction_sky_tower_actual_speed = DOP_construction_base_speed }
	add_to_variable = { DOP_construction_sky_tower_actual_speed = DOP_construction_sky_tower_speed_add }
	multiply_variable = { DOP_construction_sky_tower_actual_speed = DOP_construction_sky_tower_speed_factor }
	set_temp_variable = { DOP_construction_input_sum = DOP_construction_sky_tower_funding }
	add_to_temp_variable = { DOP_construction_input_sum = DOP_construction_sky_tower_manpower }
	divide_temp_variable = { DOP_construction_input_sum = 100 }
	multiply_variable = { DOP_construction_sky_tower_actual_speed = DOP_construction_input_sum }
	clamp_variable = { var = DOP_construction_sky_tower_actual_speed min = 0 }
	set_variable = { DOP_construction_sky_tower_percent = DOP_construction_sky_tower_progress }
	divide_variable = { DOP_construction_sky_tower_percent = 150000 }
	multiply_variable = { DOP_construction_sky_tower_percent = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = DOP_construction_sky_tower_percent min = 0 max = 100 }
}

DOP_construction_sky_tower_complete_if_needed = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DOP_construction_sky_tower_completed } check_variable = { DOP_construction_sky_tower_progress >= 150000 } }
		set_variable = { DOP_construction_sky_tower_progress = 150000 }
		set_variable = { DOP_construction_sky_tower_percent = 100 }
		set_country_flag = DOP_construction_sky_tower_completed
		country_event = { id = DOP_GNG_construction.1 days = 1 }
	}
}

DOP_construction_sky_tower_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DOP_construction_sky_tower_completed } }
		DOP_construction_sky_tower_recalculate = yes
		add_to_variable = { DOP_construction_sky_tower_progress = DOP_construction_sky_tower_actual_speed }
		DOP_construction_sky_tower_complete_if_needed = yes
	}
}

		add_to_variable = { DOP_construction_honghe_fan_asia_friendship_pass_progress = DOP_construction_honghe_fan_asia_friendship_pass_actual_speed }
		DOP_construction_honghe_fan_asia_friendship_pass_complete_if_needed = yes
	}
}

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DOP_construction_selected_range > 0 } } divide_variable = { DOP_construction_funding_thumb_x = DOP_construction_selected_range } }
	multiply_variable = { DOP_construction_funding_thumb_x = 300 }
	add_to_variable = { DOP_construction_funding_thumb_x = 6 }
	set_variable = { DOP_construction_manpower_thumb_x = DOP_construction_selected_manpower }
	subtract_from_variable = { DOP_construction_manpower_thumb_x = DOP_construction_selected_manpower_min }
	set_temp_variable = { DOP_construction_selected_range = DOP_construction_selected_manpower_max }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { DOP_construction_selected_range = DOP_construction_selected_manpower_min }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DOP_construction_selected_range > 0 } } divide_variable = { DOP_construction_manpower_thumb_x = DOP_construction_selected_range } }
	multiply_variable = { DOP_construction_manpower_thumb_x = 300 }
	add_to_variable = { DOP_construction_manpower_thumb_x = 6 }
}

		limit = { check_variable = { DOP_construction_selected = 1 } }
		set_variable = { DOP_construction_sky_tower_manpower = DOP_construction_sky_tower_manpower_max }
		clamp_variable = { var = DOP_construction_sky_tower_manpower min = DOP_construction_sky_tower_manpower_min max = DOP_construction_sky_tower_manpower_max }
		DOP_construction_sky_tower_recalculate = yes

DOP_construction_set_base_speed = {
	set_variable = { DOP_construction_base_speed = DOP_construction_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = DOP_construction_base_speed min = 0 }
	DOP_construction_sky_tower_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_rose_garden_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_alice_dream_factory_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_daya_bay_nuclear_plant_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_guangdong_shinkansen_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_chaoshan_university_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_xinfengjiang_reservoir_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_luoding_granary_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_pinglu_canal_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_south_china_sea_drilling_platform_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_wenchang_space_center_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_guangxi_industrial_institute_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_guangxi_expressway_network_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_nanyue_folk_memorial_park_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_lijiang_waterway_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_honghe_fan_asia_friendship_pass_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_sync_selected = yes
}

DOP_construction_sky_tower_set_progress = {
	set_variable = { DOP_construction_sky_tower_progress = DOP_construction_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = DOP_construction_sky_tower_progress min = 0 }
	DOP_construction_sky_tower_recalculate = yes
	DOP_construction_sky_tower_complete_if_needed = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DOP_construction_selected = 1 } } DOP_construction_sync_selected = yes }
}

	add_to_variable = { DOP_construction_sky_tower_progress = DOP_construction_value }

	clamp_variable = { var = DOP_construction_sky_tower_funding_max min = DOP_construction_sky_tower_funding_min max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = DOP_construction_sky_tower_funding min = DOP_construction_sky_tower_funding_min max = DOP_construction_sky_tower_funding_max }
